title: U2 celebrate 50 years in music with surprise gigs
summary: They could have filled a stadium or two for this golden anniversary, but U2 decided to go back to their roots and mark 50 years as a band with a few low-key gigs in their hometown of Dublin. We take a closer look.
author: Olivia SALAZAR WINSPEAR
